case.sentence: Refused bail and remained jailed after the April 17, 1961 picketing arrest. Exact release date unverified. Smith subsequently testified that he served thirty days for the April picketing.

entries.rationale: Contemporary CORElator April1961 page1 names this person among four picketers arrested April17 and remaining jailed after refusing bail.
